model: White and Color Ambiance A19 E26 1100 lm (046677591168)
name: Philips Hue White and Color Ambiance A19 (1100 lm, US)

radios.note: Hue lists Bluetooth and Zigbee. CSA's 1100lm A19/A60 Matter listing also gives a Thread transport, but we can't tie it to this product code, so Thread is not listed here.

matter.note: Official sources disagree. CSA's 'White and Color Ambiance 1100lm A19/A60' listing gives Thread and Bluetooth transport (Matter 1.3), but Hue's page for this product code lists only Bluetooth and Zigbee. Hue's guide also offers Matter through the Hue Bridge.

apple_home.note: Hue's product page lists Apple Home under 'Hue Bridge required'; the Bridge links via HomeKit or Matter. If this bulb is the CSA-listed Thread model it may also pair directly via Matter; not confirmed.

google_home.note: Hue's own integration. Hue's FAQ and Google support pages say Bluetooth bulbs work bridgeless with Google Nest speakers and displays only; the product page lists Google under 'Hue Bridge required', which unlocks full features.

alexa.note: Hue's own integration. Hue's FAQ and Alexa setup page say Bluetooth bulbs can be added directly on supported Echo devices; the product page lists Alexa under 'Hue Bridge required', which adds the Hue skill and more features.

smartthings.note: Hue's product page lists SmartThings under 'Hue Bridge required'. Direct Matter pairing is unconfirmed for this product code (see Matter).

home_assistant.note: Official Hue integration (via Hue Bridge) and official Hue BLE integration (2025.12, bridgeless Bluetooth). The BLE docs name specific Hue models and say others should work; this product code isn't named.

hubRequired.note: Basic control works over Bluetooth from the Hue app (up to 10 lights, one room). A Hue Bridge is needed for Apple Home, SmartThings, remote access and larger setups.

localControl.note: Bluetooth control from a phone needs no internet; the Hue Bridge also offers a local API that Home Assistant uses.

colorType.note: Full colour plus tunable white; Hue quotes a 1000–20000 K range.

lumens.note: Up to 1100 lm per Hue's page for product code 046677591168. Hue also sells A19 colour bulbs with lower output (e.g. 800 lm), so check the code on the box.

summary: Hue's own integrations connect the Philips Hue White and Color Ambiance A19 to Alexa and Google Home, either bridgeless over Bluetooth on supported Echo and Google Nest speakers or through a Hue Bridge. Apple Home and SmartThings need the Bridge, and Home Assistant has official integrations for both routes. This US version (product code 046677591168) is a full-colour bulb with an E26 base, rated up to 1100 lumens. Matter is unconfirmed: CSA lists an 1100 lm A19/A60 Hue bulb, but Hue's page for this code mentions only Bluetooth and Zigbee.
caveats: Apple Home and SmartThings need a Hue Bridge; direct Matter pairing isn't confirmed for this product code.
Without a Bridge, Google control works only from Google Nest speakers and displays.
Bluetooth mode tops out at about 10 lights in one room and has no remote access.
Hue also sells lower-output A19 colour bulbs (e.g. 800 lm), so check for product code 046677591168 on the box.
